seo.title: What's on, month by month | TripAgent
seo.description: The festivals, races and moments worth timing a trip around: a year of the world's great events, month by month, across our cities.

hero.lede: The festivals, races and rare moments worth building a trip around: a year of the world, across our cities. Find the month, find the reason to go.

events.name: Mubadala Abu Dhabi Open
events.body: WTA 500 women's tennis at Zayed Sports City (31 Jan–7 Feb 2026), a strong early-season field.

events.name: Al Dhafra Festival
events.body: A serious Emirati heritage festival in the Liwa region built around camel-beauty (mazayna) contests: the country's Bedouin culture, not its skyline.

events.name: Lohri
events.body: The Punjabi winter bonfire festival, marked warmly across the city with music and food.

events.name: Amsterdam Light Festival
events.body: Illuminated artworks along the canals, best seen from a heated boat on a cold winter evening.

events.name: Subhash Mela
events.body: A festival at the Cellular Jail marking Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's birthday, tied to the islands' freedom history.

events.name: Auckland Anniversary Regatta
events.body: One of the world's largest one-day sailing regattas fills the harbour, the clearest expression of the City of Sails.

events.name: Cape Town Minstrel Carnival (Kaapse Klopse)
events.body: The city's oldest carnival: thousands of costumed minstrels with banjos and ghoema drums parade through the streets.

events.name: Margazhi Music Season
events.body: The world's largest classical-music festival, with hundreds of Carnatic concerts across the city; the reason serious culture-lovers come.

events.name: Pongal
events.body: Tamil Nadu's harvest festival, the state's most important, marked with kolam art and feasting.

events.name: Mylapore Festival
events.body: A heritage street festival around the Kapaleeshwarar temple, with kolam contests, crafts and performance.

events.name: Chennai Sangamam
events.body: A large open, free festival of Tamil folk arts staged across public spaces alongside Pongal.

events.name: Duruthu Perahera
events.body: A large temple procession at Kelaniya on the edge of Colombo, with drummers, dancers and caparisoned elephants.

events.name: Dubai Shopping Festival
events.body: The city's biggest retail and entertainment season, with nightly fireworks, concerts and citywide sales.

events.name: TradFest
events.body: Traditional and folk music across Dublin Castle, cathedrals and Temple Bar venues.

events.name: Edinburgh's Hogmanay
events.body: Scotland's landmark New Year celebration, with a torchlight procession and street party.

events.name: Galle Literary Festival
events.body: South Asia's leading literary gathering, staged in the fort's colonial buildings: the 2026 edition runs 22–25 January.

events.name: Tet (Vietnamese Lunar New Year)
events.body: The country's biggest holiday; Hanoi empties of traffic and fills with kumquat trees and peach blossom, though many shops close for several days.

events.name: Jaipur Literature Festival
events.body: The world's largest free literary festival, a genuine cultural draw that fills the city; book lodging far ahead.

events.name: Jaisalmer Desert Festival
events.body: Three days of camel races, folk music and dune performances, culminating at Sam sand dunes.

events.name: Thaipusam at Batu Caves
events.body: One of the world's largest Tamil Hindu processions, with devotees carrying kavadi up the cave steps.

events.name: Royal Langkawi International Regatta
events.body: An international fleet racing in the Andaman Sea off the island: the calmest, driest month to visit.

events.name: Winter Carnival, Manali
events.body: A cold-season festival of local culture, food and snow sports in the town.

events.name: Thaipoosam Cavadee
events.body: Tamil devotees carry flower-decked kavadi and pierce their skin in honour of Lord Muruga.

events.name: Chinese New Year (Spring Festival)
events.body: Firecrackers and celebration in Port Louis's Chinatown; dates shift with the lunar calendar.

events.name: Australian Open
events.body: The year's first tennis Grand Slam, taking over Melbourne Park for a fortnight.

events.name: Peak clear-weather season
events.body: The post-monsoon and dry-winter windows give the clearest tea-country light and best walking.

events.name: Muscat Festival
events.body: A month of crafts, culture and food across the city's parks during the cool season.

events.name: Republic Day parade
events.body: The nation's grand military and cultural parade down Kartavya Path.

events.name: Festa de São Sebastião
events.body: The city's patron-saint day, marked by a procession through the centre.

events.name: Mozart Week
events.body: The Mozarteum's festival around the composer's birthday, drawing leading orchestras.

events.name: Winter Carnival
events.body: A festive cold-season carnival with music and local culture as the snow sets in.

events.name: Chinese New Year
events.body: Chinatown lights up and the Chingay parade fills the streets: the city's biggest celebration.

events.name: Singapore Art Week
events.body: Anchored by ART SG, the region's largest fair, with gallery openings across the island.

events.name: Snow Polo World Cup St. Moritz
events.body: Three days of top-level polo on the frozen lake.

events.name: Shilpgram Utsav
events.body: The big crafts-and-folk fair at the Shilpgram rural arts village, drawing artisans from across western India.

events.name: Taj Mahotsav
events.body: A ten-day arts, crafts and cuisine festival near the Taj celebrating Mughal-era culture.

events.name: Carnaval Porteño
events.body: Neighbourhood murga troupes and free street corsos across more than twenty barrios; a local, unglossed carnival.

events.name: Carnaval (Cozumel & Cancún)
events.body: Parades, music and costume across the coast in the days before Lent, with Cozumel's carnival the most traditional.

events.name: Navam Perahera
events.body: Colombo's own grand full-moon procession from the Gangaramaya Temple, with dozens of elephants moving through the city by night.

events.name: Losar (Tibetan New Year)
events.body: The Buddhist new year, marked with masked dances at the town's Tibetan monasteries.

events.name: Taste of Dubai
events.body: The city's flagship food festival, with restaurant showcases, chef demos and tastings across a weekend.

events.name: Feast of St Blaise (Sveti Vlaho)
events.body: The patron saint's day, a UNESCO-listed procession: the Old Town at its most local, with no cruise ships in sight.

events.name: Goa Carnival
events.body: A Portuguese-legacy street carnival with floats and parades in the days before Lent, centred on Panjim.

events.name: Dong Da Festival
events.body: Held on the 5th day of the lunar new year at Dong Da mound, it commemorates Emperor Quang Trung's 1789 rout of the invading Qing army.

events.name: Perfume Pagoda Festival
events.body: A months-long pilgrimage southwest of Hanoi where over a million make the boat-and-climb journey to the sacred cave temple.

events.name: Tet (Lunar New Year)
events.meta: Ho Chi Minh City · mid-Feb (17 Feb 2026)
events.body: Nguyen Hue walking street becomes a vast flower festival; the city glows but many kitchens and shops close for the holiday.

events.name: Chinese New Year Night Parade
events.body: Floats and performers process through Tsim Sha Tsui on the first night of the lunar year, followed by harbour fireworks.

events.name: World Sacred Spirit Festival
events.body: An intimate festival of devotional and Sufi music held within the fort.

events.name: Losar (Ladakhi New Year)
events.body: The Buddhist new year, an intimate winter festival for those who brave the cold, closed season.

events.name: Maha Shivaratri
events.body: Hundreds of thousands walk barefoot to Grand Bassin carrying kanwars: the island's largest Hindu pilgrimage.

events.name: Zona Maco
events.body: Latin America's leading contemporary art fair, filling the city with openings.

events.name: Miami International Boat Show
events.body: One of the world's largest boat shows, a fixture of the city's on-water calendar over Presidents' Day weekend.

events.name: Milan Fashion Week
events.body: The women's shows twice a year turn the city into fashion's world capital.

events.name: Kala Ghoda Arts Festival
events.body: A well-run nine-day street arts festival in the Fort district, good for design, film and installations.

events.name: Qutub / India Art Fair season
events.body: India's leading art fair draws collectors, alongside heritage festivals in the cooler months.

events.name: Nice Carnival
events.body: One of the world's great carnivals, with flower battles and huge floats along the Promenade des Anglais.

events.name: Fête du Citron (Menton Lemon Festival)
events.body: Giant sculptures built from citrus fruit in nearby Menton: a short train ride east.

events.name: Punakha Drubchen & Tshechu
events.body: A dramatic re-enactment of a 17th-century battle precedes the tshechu at Punakha Dzong.

events.name: Winter safari season
events.body: Cool, comfortable game drives and clear light; the most pleasant conditions for extended safaris.

events.name: Winter Lights Festival
events.body: Museums, pools and buildings lit up across the darkest weeks: paired well with aurora season.

events.name: Rio Carnival
events.meta: Rio de Janeiro · February (dates shift; 13–17 Feb in 2026)
events.body: The Sambadrome parades plus hundreds of free street blocos across the city.

events.name: Shivratri
events.body: A significant night for this Shiva-associated pilgrimage town, with all-night devotion.

events.name: Peak snow season
events.body: The most reliable window for snowfall around Shimla and Kufri, though weekends draw heavy crowds.

events.name: White Turf
events.body: Horse racing and skijoring across three Sundays on the lake.

events.name: Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras
events.body: Weeks of events building to the Oxford Street parade, one of the world's largest.

events.name: Pingxi & Taipei Lantern Festival
events.body: The lantern season peaks with sky-lantern releases in Pingxi and large illuminated displays across Taipei around the first full moon of the lunar year.

events.name: Udaipur World Music Festival
events.body: A weekend of international and Indian acts across lakeside and heritage stages in the City of Lakes.

events.name: Vancouver International Wine Festival
events.body: The city's serious oenophile week, with a themed region and a large public tasting hall.

events.name: Mahashivratri
events.body: The great night of Shiva fills the temples of his holiest city; date follows the lunar calendar.

events.name: Carnevale di Venezia
events.body: The masked carnival: costumed balls in private palazzi and the flight of the angel over St Mark's Square.

events.name: Vienna Opera Ball
events.body: The grandest night of the ball season, held on the transformed State Opera stage.

events.name: Sauti za Busara
events.body: East Africa's leading music festival fills Stone Town's Old Fort over a long weekend of live African acts.

events.name: Tulip season and Keukenhof
events.body: The bulb fields and the gardens outside the city are at their peak; the single reason many travellers time spring here.

events.name: Pasifika Festival
events.body: The largest Pacific-culture festival in the world, with village stages, food and performance at Western Springs.

events.name: Nyepi (Day of Silence)
events.body: The Balinese New Year, preceded by the Ogoh-Ogoh effigy parades and followed by a full day when the entire island falls silent.

events.name: Karaga
events.body: An ancient, atmospheric night procession through the old city, one of Bengaluru's oldest living traditions.

events.name: Cape Town International Jazz Festival
events.body: Africa's grandest jazz gathering, two days of local and international acts across multiple stages at the CTICC.

events.name: Señor de los Temblores (Holy Monday)
events.body: A revered procession of the 'Lord of the Earthquakes' through the old city during Holy Week.

events.name: First-flush tea season
events.body: The prized spring plucking, the best time to experience the estates at work.

events.name: Dubai World Cup
events.body: The world's richest race day at Meydan on the last Saturday of March, a full dress-code social occasion.

events.name: Art Dubai
events.body: The region's leading contemporary and modern art fair at Madinat Jumeirah, anchor of Dubai's art season.

events.name: St. Patrick's Festival
events.body: Several days of events around the 17 March parade through the city.

events.name: Shigmo
events.body: Goa's Hindu spring festival, a colourful procession of folk dancers and floats, the local counterpart to Holi.

events.name: Hue Festival
events.meta: Hoi An & Da Nang · late Mar–Apr (biennial)
events.body: A short drive north, the former imperial capital stages a major cultural festival of royal ritual, music and craft.

events.name: Gangaur
events.body: An 18-day festival ending in a grand ceremonial procession, one of Rajasthan's most photographed.

events.name: Holi
events.body: Celebrated with folk colour among the sandstone lanes, best experienced at a heritage haveli.

events.name: Academy Awards
events.body: The ceremony itself is closed, but the city's energy, parties and restaurant scene peak around Oscars weekend.

events.name: ASICS Los Angeles Marathon
events.body: The Stadium-to-the-Stars course runs from Dodger Stadium to Century City, closing swathes of the city for a morning.

events.name: Melbourne International Comedy Festival
events.body: The world's largest dedicated comedy festival, hundreds of shows across the city.

events.name: Ultra Music Festival
events.body: Electronic-music weekend at Bayfront Park that headlines Miami Music Week.

events.name: Starkbierfest (strong beer season)
events.body: Lenten strong-beer festivals, centred on Paulaner's Nockherberg, with far fewer tourists than Oktoberfest.

events.name: WRC Safari Rally Kenya
events.body: The historic World Rally round runs on the rough tracks around Lake Naivasha, a couple of hours from Nairobi.

events.name: Paro Tshechu
events.body: Masked dances at Rinpung Dzong, closing with the dawn unfurling of the giant Guru Thongdrel tapestry.

events.name: International Yoga Festival
events.body: A week of teachers and practitioners from around the world at Parmarth Niketan, the town's signature gathering.

events.name: Holy Week & Easter
events.body: Rome's most solemn season, with the papal ceremonies and the Via Crucis at the Colosseum drawing pilgrims from everywhere.

events.name: Tulip Festival
events.body: Asia's largest tulip garden below the Zabarwan hills blooms for a few weeks; the signature spring event.

events.name: Almond blossom season
events.body: The Badamwari garden's almond trees flower, marking the first sign of the Kashmiri spring.

events.name: Cherry blossom (sakura) season
events.body: A roughly ten-day window when the city's parks and canals bloom; the most beautiful and most contested time to visit.

events.name: Baisakhi
events.body: The Sikh new year and harvest festival, celebrated with great fervour at the Golden Temple; the peak time to witness the faith.

events.name: King's Day (Koningsdag)
events.body: The whole city turns orange and takes to the streets and canals for the country's biggest party; book rooms far ahead.

events.name: Peak diving & clear-water season
events.body: The dry season with the calmest seas and best visibility; the window to time a trip around the reefs.

events.name: Songkran
events.body: Thai New Year, marked by temple blessings and city-wide water fights; joyous but book far ahead and expect to get wet.

events.name: Sant Jordi
events.body: Catalonia's day of books and roses: the streets fill with stalls and readers.

events.name: Sinhala & Tamil New Year
events.body: Traditional games, sweets and rituals fill the villages around the fort.

events.name: Reunification Day
events.body: Marks the end of the war in 1975 with parades and fireworks, and is felt most sharply in the city where it happened.

events.name: Istanbul Tulip Festival
events.body: Millions of tulips planted across Emirgan Park and the city's squares, honouring the flower's Ottoman origins.

events.name: Kochi-Muziris Biennale
events.body: India's leading contemporary-art event, staged in warehouses and heritage buildings across the fort.

events.name: Thrissur Pooram (nearby)
events.body: The spectacular caparisoned-elephant temple festival is a short trip north, among India's grandest.

events.name: Songkran
events.body: Thai New Year, marked with water-splashing and temple visits across the province at the height of the hot season.

events.name: Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival
events.body: Two hours east in Indio; the marquee festival that empties fashionable LA into the desert.

events.name: Carnaval International de Victoria
events.body: A colourful international parade through the capital celebrating the islands' mixed heritage.

events.name: Salone del Mobile (Design Week)
events.body: The world's biggest furniture and design fair, spilling into installations across every district.

events.name: Arrowtown Autumn Festival
events.body: The old gold town celebrates its turning trees with markets and a heritage parade.

events.name: Peak tiger-sighting season
events.body: The hottest months draw tigers to the water, giving the best odds of a sighting despite the heat.

events.name: Natale di Roma
events.body: The city's own birthday, marked with historical re-enactments and a costumed parade through the Circus Maximus and the Fori.

events.name: Greek Orthodox Easter
events.body: Candlelit processions and fireworks in the villages: the islands' most moving celebration; date follows the Orthodox calendar.

events.name: Cherry blossom season
events.body: Yeouido and the palace grounds bloom for roughly a week: the city's prettiest, busiest moment.

events.name: Longhua Temple Fair
events.body: One of Shanghai's oldest folk fairs fills the grounds of its most important temple with performances and craft stalls.

events.name: Sipi Fair
events.body: A traditional spring fair in nearby Mashobra, a window into local Pahari culture.

events.name: Angkor Sankranta (Khmer New Year)
events.body: Cambodia's biggest celebration, with games and blessings staged around the temples themselves.

events.name: Mewar Festival
events.body: A spring festival tied to Gangaur, with a Lake Pichola boat procession and City Palace celebrations honouring the goddess.

events.name: Zermatt Unplugged
events.body: An acoustic music festival across village and mountain stages: the 2026 edition runs 7–11 April.

events.name: Sechseläuten
events.body: Zurich's guild spring festival, culminating in the burning of the Böögg snowman to predict the summer.

events.name: Monsoon (to avoid)
events.body: Heavy rain and rough seas disrupt ferries and diving; worth planning around by staying away.

events.name: Primavera Sound
events.body: One of Europe's leading music festivals, drawing global acts to the seafront.

events.name: Whale shark season
events.body: The window when whale sharks gather off Isla Mujeres and Isla Holbox; the region's signature wildlife encounter.

events.name: Vesak
events.body: The most important Buddhist holiday; Colombo fills with lanterns and illuminated pandals, and free food stalls line the streets.

events.name: Da Nang International Fireworks Festival
events.meta: Hoi An & Da Nang · late May–mid Jul (Sat nights)
events.body: International teams compete over successive Saturday nights along the Han River: the region's biggest set-piece event.

events.name: Cheung Chau Bun Festival
events.body: The outlying island's centuries-old festival culminates in a bun-scrambling race up towers and the floating-children Piu Sik parade.

events.name: Aoi Matsuri
events.body: The oldest of Kyoto's three great festivals: a Heian-era court procession in ox-carts and silk from the Imperial Palace to the Kamo shrines.

events.name: LIMA (Langkawi International Maritime & Aerospace Exhibition)
events.body: A biennial defence and aerospace showcase with public flying displays over the bay: book far ahead, the island fills.

events.name: Chelsea Flower Show
events.body: The RHS's flagship show and a fixture of the London season.

events.name: Fiestas de San Isidro
events.body: Madrid's patron-saint festival brings open-air verbenas, chotis dancing and concerts across the old city.

events.name: Hadimba Devi Fair
events.body: A local temple festival at the atmospheric wooden Hadimba shrine among the cedars.

events.name: Roland-Garros (French Open)
events.body: The clay-court Grand Slam; the toughest ticket in Paris and worth timing a spring trip around.

events.name: Prague Spring International Music Festival
events.body: The country's premier classical festival, opening with Smetana's Má vlast.

events.name: Ganga Dussehra
events.body: A river festival honouring the descent of the Ganga, with special aartis and bathing on the ghats.

events.name: Buddha's Birthday / Lotus Lantern Festival
events.body: A lantern parade through central Seoul and temples strung with color: dates follow the lunar calendar.

events.name: Summer Festival
events.body: A week of cultural performances and events on the Ridge, marking the start of the hill-station season.

events.name: Vivid Sydney
events.body: The city lights up nightly with projections, music and ideas across the harbour.

events.name: Sanja Matsuri
events.body: Asakusa's wild three-day shrine festival, a hundred mikoshi carried through the streets: old Tokyo at full volume.

events.name: Venice Biennale (Art)
events.body: The 61st International Art Exhibition across the Giardini, the Arsenale and pavilions scattered through the city.

events.name: Wiener Festwochen
events.body: The city's leading festival of theatre, opera, dance and music.

events.name: Champakulam Moolam Boat Race
events.body: Kerala's oldest snake-boat race, on the Pamba river near Alleppey.

events.name: Athens Epidaurus Festival
events.body: The city's great summer season of theatre, music and dance, staged at the Odeon of Herodes Atticus and the ancient theatre of Epidaurus.

events.name: Bali Arts Festival
events.body: A month-long celebration of Balinese dance, music and craft centred on Denpasar; the island's cultural high point.

events.name: Inti Raymi
events.body: The Inca Festival of the Sun, re-enacted at Sacsayhuamán: the Andes' greatest pageant, fixed on 24 June.

events.name: Corpus Christi
events.body: Saints' processions and feasting fill the Plaza de Armas in the run-up to Inti Raymi.

events.name: Bloomsday
events.body: The city retraces Joyce's Ulysses in Edwardian dress.

events.name: Calcio Storico Fiorentino
events.body: A brutal, costumed 16th-century football tournament in Piazza Santa Croce, climaxing on the feast of San Giovanni.

events.name: Fête de la Musique
events.body: Three days of free concerts across squares and courtyards throughout the old town for the summer solstice.

events.name: Istanbul Music Festival
events.body: Turkey's leading classical festival, staging concerts in historic venues from Hagia Irene to Bosphorus palaces.

events.name: Istanbul Jazz Festival
events.body: Jazz, soul and world music across the city's iconic stages, from parks to waterfront terraces.

events.name: Sagra di San Giovanni, Isola Comacina
events.meta: Lake Como · last weekend of June
events.body: The lake's only island lit by fireworks and floating candles, recalling its medieval destruction: Como's most atmospheric night.

events.name: Hemis Festival
events.body: The largest monastic festival in Ladakh, with masked cham dances at Hemis Gompa; dates follow the Tibetan calendar.

events.name: Sindhu Darshan
events.body: A riverside festival on the banks of the Indus celebrating the river and Ladakhi culture.

events.name: Festas de Santo António (Santos Populares)
events.body: The city's biggest street party, peaking on the night of the 12th with grilled sardines, marchas and neighbourhood dancing.

events.name: Wimbledon
events.body: The oldest tennis championship, and London's summer social centrepiece.

events.name: Spiti / high-pass access season
events.body: The window when the high roads over Kunzum and towards Spiti open; the reason to time a longer trip.

events.name: Marrakech Comedy Festival (Marrakech du Rire)
events.body: The city's headline comedy weekend, now under a new name and home at the Palais des Congrès.

events.name: Tribeca Festival
events.body: Robert De Niro's downtown film festival, when premieres and talks take over lower Manhattan for a fortnight.

events.name: Fête de la Musique
events.body: The whole city becomes a free stage on the solstice: every square and street corner has live music until late.

events.name: Festa de São João do Porto
events.body: The city's exuberant midsummer festival of bonfires, grilled sardines, plastic hammers and a midnight fireworks display over the river.

events.name: NOS Primavera Sound
events.body: A three-day international indie and electronic festival in the Parque da Cidade, an offshoot of the Barcelona original.

events.name: Queenstown Winter Festival
events.body: Ten days of fireworks, street parties and mountain events opening the ski season.

events.name: Estate Romana
events.body: The summer-long festival of open-air cinema, concerts and events along the Tiber and across the city's squares.

events.name: Shanghai International Film Festival
events.body: China's leading film festival brings hundreds of screenings and its Golden Goblet competition to cinemas across the city.

events.name: Dragon Boat Festival
events.body: Dragon-boat races on the Keelung and Dahan rivers mark one of Taiwan's oldest holidays, with zongzi eaten citywide.

events.name: Ravello Festival
events.body: A summer-long programme of orchestral concerts and recitals on the Villa Rufolo terrace above the sea.

events.name: Zanzibar International Film Festival (ZIFF)
events.body: Screenings and performances across Stone Town's historic venues, the region's oldest film festival.

events.name: Jerash Festival
events.body: Jordan's flagship culture festival, staged among the floodlit Roman ruins north of Amman.

events.name: Cappadocia Balloon Festival (BalonFest)
events.body: A mass ascension of dozens of special-shape balloons from around the world each morning, free to watch from any ridge.

events.name: Copenhagen Jazz Festival
events.body: Ten days of over a thousand concerts across squares, courtyards and clubs, many of them free and outdoors.

events.name: Dubrovnik Summer Festival
events.body: Six weeks of theatre and classical concerts staged on the ramparts and in courtyards across the Old Town since 1950.

events.name: Palio di Siena (nearby)
events.body: An easy excursion to Siena for the bareback horse race around the Piazza del Campo, the great spectacle of Tuscany.

events.name: Esala Perahera season (island-wide)
events.body: The great Kandy procession draws travellers up-country during Galle's dry, bright months.

events.name: Bonalu
events.body: A vibrant folk festival honouring the goddess Mahakali across the twin cities' temples.

events.name: Gion Matsuri
events.body: The month-long summer festival of the Yasaka shrine, peaking with the towering Yamaboko float processions and the yoiyama street evenings before them.

events.name: Bellagio e Lago di Como Festival
events.body: A summer season of chamber and orchestral concerts in lakefront churches and villa gardens.

events.name: Fiestas Patrias (Independence)
events.body: Two national holidays of parades and celebration across the capital.

events.name: Mad Cool Festival
events.body: The city's major international music festival, held over four days at the Iberdrola Music grounds in Villaverde.

events.name: Salalah Khareef
events.body: In Oman's far south, the monsoon turns the hills green: a summer escape unlike anywhere else in Arabia.

events.name: Nice Jazz Fest
events.body: A summer institution of over 70 years, staged in the heart of the city.

events.name: Jazz à Juan (Juan-les-Pins)
events.body: The legendary seaside jazz festival along the coast at Antibes.

events.name: Tenjin Matsuri
events.body: One of Japan's three great festivals, ending with a river procession of boats and fireworks over the Okawa.

events.name: Salzburg Festival
events.meta: Salzburg · Mid-July to end of August
events.body: Six weeks of opera, drama and concerts, the city's cultural centrepiece.

events.name: Shikara Festival
events.body: A summer lake festival with decorated-boat races and cultural events on Dal Lake.

events.name: Sumida River Fireworks Festival
events.body: Around 20,000 fireworks over the river between Asakusa and the Skytree, the city's grandest summer night.

events.name: Toronto Caribbean Carnival (Caribana)
events.body: North America's largest Caribbean festival, culminating in the Grand Parade along Lakeshore Boulevard.

events.name: Vivid: Celebration of Light (fireworks)
events.body: Barge-launched international fireworks competition over English Bay across several nights.

events.name: Zermatt Marathon
events.body: A punishing summer run climbing from the valley up towards the Matterhorn.

events.name: Ram Barat
events.body: A vast, spectacular local wedding-procession festival unique to Agra, staged with great pageantry.

events.name: Nehru Trophy Boat Race
events.body: Kerala's most famous snake-boat race on Punnamada Lake: the 2026 edition is 22 August.

events.name: Onam
events.body: Kerala's harvest festival, with flower carpets, feasts and village boat races; date follows the Malayalam calendar.

events.name: Sziget Festival
events.body: One of Europe's largest music festivals, held on an island in the Danube.

events.name: St Stephen's Day
events.body: The national holiday, marked by a grand fireworks display over the Danube.

events.name: Tango BA Festival y Mundial
events.body: The world's largest tango gathering, culminating in the World Championship finals at the Gran Rex; free events fill the city.

events.name: Copenhagen Cooking & Food Festival
events.body: Northern Europe's largest food festival, with tastings, pop-ups and dinners across the city's restaurants and markets.

events.name: Edinburgh Festival Fringe
events.body: Roughly the first three weeks of the month; the city's defining event.

events.name: Edinburgh International Festival
events.body: The curated classical, opera and theatre programme that runs alongside the Fringe.

events.name: Teej
events.body: A monsoon festival with a colourful royal procession honouring the goddess Parvati through the old city.

events.name: Onam
events.body: Kerala's grand harvest festival, with flower carpets, feasts and boat races across the region.

events.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
events.body: The city's biggest festival, ending in vast processions to the sea; thrilling but expect road closures and dense crowds.

events.name: Onam
events.body: Kerala's harvest festival is celebrated warmly on the estates, with feasts and floral decorations.

events.name: XLSIOR Festival
events.body: One of the world's largest LGBTQ+ dance festivals, taking over the island's clubs and beach venues for five to six days.

events.name: Great Wildebeest Migration river crossings
events.body: Peak crossing season in the Mara; the exact days are unpredictable, so allow several nights and book camps 12-18 months ahead.

events.name: US Open (tennis)
events.body: The season's final Grand Slam in Flushing Meadows, the loudest and latest-running of the four.

events.name: Ganesh Chaturthi at Trinetra Ganesh (fort temple)
events.body: A major pilgrimage to the ancient Ganesh temple inside Ranthambore Fort.

events.name: Reykjavik Culture Night (Menningarnótt)
events.body: A single night when the whole city opens its doors with concerts, art and a harbour fireworks finale.

events.name: Outside Lands
events.body: The city's big music, food and wine festival in Golden Gate Park.

events.name: St. Moritz Gourmet Festival
events.body: Visiting chefs cook across the town's hotels over a week.

events.name: Canadian National Exhibition (CNE)
events.body: The 18-day fair with rides, pavilions and the Labour Day air show: a long-running end-of-summer tradition.

events.name: Folklore Festival
events.body: Alpine traditions, yodelling and flag-throwing fill the car-free streets in high summer.

events.name: Street Parade
events.body: The world's largest techno street party, drawing hundreds of thousands along the lakefront.

events.name: Petra Desert Marathon
events.body: A trail race through the ancient city and surrounding desert, drawing runners from around the world.

events.name: La Mercè
events.body: The city's patron-saint festival, with human towers, fire runs and street concerts.

events.name: Dasara (nearby Mysuru)
events.body: The royal Mysuru festival is an easy trip away and among South India's grandest, with the illuminated palace.

events.name: Budapest Wine Festival
events.body: Hungarian winemakers gather in the Castle District for the harvest-season tasting.

events.name: Mid-Autumn Festival
events.body: A children's festival that turns Hang Ma street and the Old Quarter into a lantern market with lion dances and mooncakes.

events.name: Mid-Autumn Festival
events.meta: Ho Chi Minh City · late Sep (25 Sep 2026)
events.body: Cho Lon's Chinatown lights up with lanterns, lion dances and mooncake stalls in the city's most atmospheric quarter.

events.name: Mid-Autumn Festival
events.meta: Hoi An & Da Nang · late Sep (25 Sep 2026)
events.body: Hoi An is at its most atmospheric now, with lion dances and lantern-making through the old-town lanes.

events.name: Bathukamma
events.body: Telangana's flower festival, when women build and float towering floral arrangements.

events.name: Indra Jatra
events.body: Eight days of masked deity dances and the Kumari chariot procession around Kathmandu Durbar Square.

events.name: Durga Puja
events.body: The city's defining festival, a UNESCO-recognised explosion of art, devotion and street life; the single best time to visit.

events.name: Ladakh Festival
events.body: A week of processions, polo, archery and folk performance across Leh, marking the season's end.

events.name: Mistura Food Festival
events.body: Latin America's largest gastronomy fair, gathering the country's cooks and produce on the coast.

events.name: Grito de Independencia
events.body: Independence night, when the Zócalo fills for the president's cry and fireworks.

events.name: Oktoberfest
events.body: The world's largest folk festival on the Theresienwiese; book months ahead.

events.name: Kishiwada Danjiri Matsuri
events.body: Teams race four-tonne wooden floats through the streets of Kishiwada, cornering them at speed in one of the country's most thrilling festivals.

events.name: Thimphu Tshechu
events.body: The capital's grand festival in the courtyard of Tashichho Dzong; dates follow the lunar calendar.

events.name: Snow Machine
events.body: A multi-day alpine music festival paired with skiing at the resorts.

events.name: Singapore Grand Prix
events.body: The original F1 night race, run through the streets around Marina Bay with headline concerts.

events.name: Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF)
events.body: One of the world's major festivals; premieres and the city's cultural energy peak in early-to-mid September.

events.name: Vancouver International Film Festival
events.body: One of North America's larger festivals, strong on Asian and Canadian cinema.

events.name: Venice Film Festival
events.body: The world's oldest film festival, on the Lido: red carpets, premieres and the Golden Lion.

events.name: Regata Storica
events.body: A historic pageant of costumed boats and gondola races down the Grand Canal.

events.name: Zurich Film Festival
events.body: The city's international film festival brings premieres and stars to venues across the centre.

events.name: Diwali
events.body: The old city lights up; a fine time to pair the monuments with festive markets, though book early.

events.name: Diwali / Bandi Chhor Divas
events.body: The temple and city are lit with lamps and fireworks reflected in the sacred tank; a beautiful night here.

events.name: Deepavali
events.body: The southern Diwali, celebrated warmly with lamps and sweets across the city's homes and temples.

events.name: Cairo Jazz Festival
events.body: A long-running gathering of Egyptian and international jazz musicians across the city's stages.

events.name: Clear-view autumn season
events.body: The most reliable window for cloud-free Kanchenjunga views after the monsoon clears.

events.name: Good Food Festival
events.body: A week of tastings, oyster and wine events across the city as the season quietens.

events.name: Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival
events.body: The Central Harbourfront fills with wine pavilions and food stalls against the skyline over four evenings.

events.name: Diwali
events.body: Jaipur is famous for its illuminated markets and lit-up buildings at Diwali; among the best in India to witness.

events.name: Diwali
events.body: The golden fort takes on the lamplight beautifully; a quiet, atmospheric time to visit.

events.name: Rajasthan International Folk Festival (RIFF)
events.body: A superb roots-music festival staged inside Mehrangarh Fort on the October full moon.

events.name: Marwar Festival
events.body: A two-day celebration of Marwari folk music and dance honouring the region's heroes.

events.name: Diwali
events.body: The blue city glows with lamps beneath the floodlit fort, a striking sight from the rooftops.

events.name: Dashain
events.body: Nepal's longest and most auspicious festival; the country empties home, so plan logistics carefully.

events.name: Tihar
events.body: The five-day festival of lights; homes and streets glow with oil lamps and marigold.

events.name: Kali Puja & Diwali
events.body: A dramatic night of goddess worship and lights following close on Durga Puja.

events.name: Jidai Matsuri
events.body: The 'Festival of the Ages': a costumed pageant marching a thousand years of Japanese history through the streets.

events.name: Señor de los Milagros (Lord of Miracles)
events.body: Purple-robed processions through the centre all month, the largest on 18 October.

events.name: Frieze London
events.body: The contemporary art fair that turns Regent's Park and the whole city into a gallery.

events.name: Festival Kreol
events.body: The country's biggest cultural festival: Creole music, food and dance across a week.

events.name: Kullu Dussehra (nearby)
events.body: The week-long valley festival at Kullu, when hundreds of village deities are carried in procession; the region's great event.

events.name: Divali
events.body: The festival of lights, with homes and hillsides across the island lit end to end.

events.name: Día de Muertos parade
events.body: A grand parade down Paseo de la Reforma into the Zócalo: 2025's runs on the weekend of 1–2 November.

events.name: Diwali
events.body: The seafront and homes light up; a fine time for the food and shopping but book restaurants early.

events.name: Diwali
events.body: The festival of lights transforms the city with lamps and fireworks; date follows the lunar calendar.

events.name: Nuit Blanche
events.body: An all-night contemporary-art takeover of the city, museums and monuments open through the small hours.

events.name: Fête des Vendanges de Montmartre
events.body: The Montmartre vineyard's harvest festival: parades, tastings and an old-Paris village mood above the city.

events.name: Phuket Vegetarian Festival
events.body: The nine-day Nine Emperor Gods festival, with white-clad devotees, temple processions and dramatic firewalking rituals.

events.name: Signal Festival
events.body: A festival of light installations that transforms the historic centre after dark.

events.name: Park reopening after monsoon
events.body: The core zones reopen with the park at its greenest and lakes full; a lovely if slightly harder-sighting time.

events.name: Hardly Strictly Bluegrass
events.body: A free roots-music festival in the park during the city's warmest, clearest weeks.

events.name: Fleet Week
events.body: The Blue Angels roar over the bay in the reliably sunny autumn window.

events.name: Santorini Experience
events.body: An open-water swim and running event set against the caldera, at the season's gentler end.

events.name: Saffron harvest (Pampore, nearby)
events.body: The purple crocus fields around Pampore bloom for the world's most prized saffron; a rare sight.

events.name: Guru Nanak Gurpurab
events.body: The birth anniversary of the founder of Sikhism, when the temple is spectacularly illuminated at night.

events.name: Athens Marathon, the Authentic
events.body: The original marathon route from the plain of Marathon into the marble Panathenaic Stadium; the classic reason to visit in autumn.

events.name: Loy Krathong
events.body: The festival of lights, when candlelit floats are set adrift on the river and canals across the city at dusk.

events.name: Cairo International Film Festival
events.body: The oldest film festival in the Arab world and Africa, drawing an international crowd to the city's cinemas and red carpets.

events.name: Ajyal Film Festival
events.body: The Doha Film Institute's week-long festival at Katara, screenings and culture for all ages.

events.name: Kolkata International Film Festival
events.body: A major, long-running film festival that fills the city's cinemas and its intellectual life.

events.name: Loy Krathong
events.body: The festival of lights, celebrated along Krabi's beaches with floating candlelit offerings at dusk.

events.name: Ironman Malaysia
events.body: The full-distance triathlon in the tropical heat, one of Asia's flagship endurance races, based out of Kuah.

events.name: Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix
events.body: The night race runs a street circuit down the Strip past Caesars and the Sphere; book far ahead as the city fills.

events.name: SUBIOS Underwater Festival
events.body: A celebration of Seychelles' marine heritage with film, exhibitions and dive events.

events.name: Republic Day
events.body: National celebration with parades and cultural displays in Malé.

events.name: Marrakech International Film Festival
events.body: The prestige film festival that brings international directors and stars to the Palais Badii and the medina squares.

events.name: Melbourne Cup Carnival
events.body: The race that stops a nation, the centrepiece of the spring racing weeks.

events.name: Tollwood Winter Festival
events.body: World music, theatre and a market on the Theresienwiese over the festive season.

events.name: Lamu Cultural Festival
events.body: Dhow races, poetry and Swahili weddings on the coastal island: a natural add-on if you extend beyond the safari.

events.name: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
events.body: The giant-balloon parade down Central Park West on Thanksgiving morning, the start of the city's holiday season.

events.name: Loy Krathong
events.body: The festival of lights, marked along the island's beaches with floating candlelit krathong at dusk.

events.name: Christmas markets
events.body: The Old Town and Wenceslas squares fill with wooden stalls and mulled wine.

events.name: Iceland Airwaves
events.body: The country's landmark music festival, with gigs in venues and record shops across downtown Reykjavik.

events.name: Kartik Purnima / Ganga aarti season
events.body: The cool-season full moon brings especially devout riverside ceremonies.

events.name: Christmas Market on Residenzplatz
events.body: The traditional Christkindlmarkt in the cathedral square.

events.name: Seoul Lantern Festival
events.body: Illuminated lanterns line the Cheonggyecheon stream through the heart of downtown.

events.name: Bon Om Touk (Water Festival)
events.body: Marks the reversal of the Tonlé Sap's flow, with boat races and river festivities.

events.name: Dev Deepawali
events.body: The 'Diwali of the gods': every ghat lined with thousands of oil lamps on Kartik Purnima.

events.name: Ganga Mahotsav
events.body: A festival of classical music and culture on the riverbank, around Dev Deepawali.

events.name: Christmas markets
events.body: Squares from Rathausplatz to Schönbrunn fill with stalls and Punsch.

events.name: Formula 1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix
events.body: The season finale at Yas Marina (3–6 December 2026), with Yasalam after-race concerts included for ticket holders.

events.name: Qatar National Day
events.body: A waterfront parade, air and sea displays and fireworks marking the country's unification.

events.name: Fête de l'Escalade
events.body: Geneva's beloved festival marking the 1602 defeat of Savoy, with torch-lit processions in period dress and chocolate cauldrons.

events.name: Sunburn Festival
events.body: India's largest electronic-music festival draws a big year-end crowd to the north; plan around it either way.

events.name: Feast of St Francis Xavier
events.body: A major pilgrimage to Old Goa honouring the state's patron saint, with the relics on rare display in exposition years.

events.name: Cochin Carnival
events.body: A ten-day Fort Kochi street festival ending on New Year's Eve with the burning of the Pappanji effigy.

events.name: Poush Mela / Christmas season
events.body: Park Street's famous Christmas lights and the nearby Santiniketan Poush Mela make December especially lively.

events.name: Wrangler National Finals Rodeo
events.body: Ten days of championship rodeo at the Thomas & Mack Center that transform the city's mood.

events.name: New Year's Eve on the Strip
events.body: Fireworks launch from the resort rooftops in one of the largest street celebrations in the country.

events.name: Fishermen's Day
events.body: A national thank-you to the fishing communities that built the country.

events.name: Art Basel Miami Beach
events.body: The city's marquee week; the fair anchors dozens of satellite shows and the design world descends.

events.name: Sant'Ambrogio & La Scala opening night
events.body: The city's patron-saint feast and the opera season's gala premiere on the same night.

events.name: Christmas & New Year
events.body: The estates and resorts fill with a festive high-season crowd; charming but book far ahead.

events.name: Réveillon (New Year's Eve on Copacabana)
events.body: Two million in white on the sand for fireworks and offerings to the sea goddess Iemanjá.

events.name: Angkor Wat International Half Marathon
events.body: A charity run through the temple grounds at first light: a rare way to see them car-free.

events.name: Sydney New Year's Eve
events.body: The world's headline midnight fireworks, staged off the bridge and harbour.
